From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>

Date: Thu, 22 Mar 2028 10:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Payor integration & PO routing for Southlake Marketplace listing

Thanks for the details, Jordan — looping in specifics from our side. Small checklist for the procurement handoff so billing ops and marketplace enablement don't hit surprises: 

- Bill-to vs Payor: confirm legal "bill-to" entity and any VAT/TAX IDs (US: EIN; EU: VAT number). AWS will require the exact legal name on invoices for reconciliation.
- AWS Marketplace notes: if they want consolidated AWS billing, we still need a purchase instrument (PO or blanket PO) from the parent. AWS invoices flow to the AWS reseller; vendor payout still goes via marketplace settlement.
- GCP Marketplace differences: GCP sometimes requires separate seller onboarding paperwork and a registration window; PO routing can be direct or through Google depending on the integration.
- Required attachments for marketplace go-live: completed seller intake form, signed PO/MSA (if parent requires), W-9 or W-8BEN if non-US, and a point-of-contact for billing disputes.

Kimberly — can you prepare a short PO-exception template in case Starlite's procurement needs an alternate routing? I recommend we also include a three-line summary for Marcus showing timeline and who signs what (MSA vs PO vs Marketplace acceptance).

Jordan/Marcus — if you can confirm whether the parent will issue a monthly blanket PO or single POs per quarter, we can map the right activation lane and estimate the go-live week.

Happy to join the call — I have availability Friday after 11:00 PT.

Cheers,
Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Marketplace Partnerships | Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
